name: dry-run-text
stdout:
! Home activates before system. If system activation fails, home may already be active.
! Once the privileged step starts, cancellation waits for it to finish before stopping subsequent steps.
! Garbage collection deletes unreferenced store paths and older generations; these cannot be rolled back afterward.
 1  Update flake inputs
    nix flake update --flake <flake>
 2  Build home configuration
    nix build --out-link <flake>/state/nix-manager/build/home --log-format internal-json --print-out-paths <flake>#homeConfigurations.user-test.activationPackage
 3  Build system configuration
    nix build --out-link <flake>/state/nix-manager/build/system --log-format internal-json --print-out-paths <flake>#nixosConfigurations.test-machine.config.system.build.toplevel
 4  Select Home Manager generation
    nix-env --profile <flake>/state/nix/profiles/home-manager --set <flake>/state/nix-manager/build/home
 5  Activate Home Manager
    <flake>/state/nix-manager/build/home/activate --driver-version 1
 6  Activate system
    <privileged> activate-output switch <flake>/state/nix-manager/build/system
 7  Keep 3 home generations
    nix-env --profile <flake>/state/nix/profiles/home-manager --delete-generations +3
 8  Keep 3 system generations and collect garbage
    <privileged> gc 3
